subject: Including data with at least one weekend day

messages.author: 494dad402cbbbe7c
messages.subject: Including data with at least one weekend day
parts:
Dear Vincent and team,

Warm greetings. I have a question regarding defining valid days in GGIR. 

Our study protocol defines a valid day as more than 16 hours of wear time in a day. We use ''argumentincludedaycrit = 16''. In addition, a subject's data is included if he/she has four valid days, including at least 1 weekend day.

Is it possible to set inclusion criteria of 1 weekend day with the current version of GGIR? If yes, what is the R script / argument for this?

Look forward to your advice on this. Thank you

messages.author: 13568954e9b4ef4b
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Including data with at least one weekend day
parts:
The person level results that GGIR produces have columns that indicates the number of valid weekend and weekdays.  So, exclusion of individuals based on number of valid weekdays or weekend days can be done by you as part of your own statistical analysis.

Vincent
